## Technical Discussion

### Fill Material Classification - Ryder Anderson
- Question: How to classify multiple fill events in soil profiles
- Guidance: 
  - Lump similar fills together (e.g., sandy loam + loam = one horizon)
  - Separate distinctly different fills (e.g., loamy fill vs. high-artifact skeletal material)
  - Label as horizon 1 and 2 when significantly different
